# kafka_user_scram_credential (List Resource)

Lists existing SCRAM credentials (one result per user and mechanism), e.g. to generate `import` blocks with `terraform query`. Passwords cannot be read from Kafka: add `password_wo` to the generated configuration before applying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every SCRAM credential (one result per user and mechanism)
list "kafka_user_scram_credential" "all" {
  provider = kafka
}

# SCRAM-SHA-512 credentials of service accounts
list "kafka_user_scram_credential" "services" {
  provider = kafka

  config {
    scram_mechanism = "SCRAM-SHA-512"
    username_prefix = "svc-"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scram_mechanism` (String) Only credentials of this mechanism: `SCRAM-SHA-256` or `SCRAM-SHA-512`.
- `username_prefix` (String) Only users whose name starts with this prefix.
